name: soundbridge/scholarship-process
title: Scholarship Process
description: Editable steps explaining the scholarship process.

default.title: Check Eligibility
default.body: Scholarships are open to any student enrolling in a SoundBridge program. There is no audition or prior experience required — just a desire to participate.

default.title: Submit a Simple Application
default.body: Complete our short application form. We ask for basic student information and a brief note about your family’s financial situation.

default.title: Receive Your Award
default.body: We’ll notify you by email within 5–7 business days. Awards vary based on available funds and family need. No family is turned away due to cost.
